modules.change: Target metadata is no longer required by a causal observation loader
SequenceStore; restored physical context is the new default; legacy mode remains explicit
Causal summary_at accepts explicit origins; future endpoint, fit and metrics stay outside features

intentional_api_changes: Imports are organized by role; no backwards dependency on archived packages.
Frame feature checkpoint contract is FEATURE_STREAM_V2 and fingerprints all extracted formulas.
Anchored profile returns only X; historical future fields remain in archive.
SequenceStore does not require targets and defaults to physical restored context.
Full-history materialization requires explicit archives and reference source.

2026-10-26: band crossing rule is bid OR ask (geometry QUOTE_NATIVE_BID_OR_ASK_CROSS_V2, bank store CROSSING_BANK_LIBRARY_V2); midpoint rule, cause classes, packets, make_targets, trade_profile, first_passage, factorized_loss, event weights and CE gradients removed from crossings.

2026-10-26: outcomes keep only facts without money (nearest_crossings, bands, endpoint, opportunity, sampled_crossing); mixed fee/equity teachers listed in archived_code stay in the archive branch with their data in data/derived.
2026-10-26: economics package added; crossing_marks reads nearest_crossings and applies the canon fee.

2026-10-26: market/full_history.py moved to features/full_history.py; FEATURES projection moved from representation/schema.py to features/families/signature.py; FinalizedSession.features removed. No upward layer imports remain.
2026-10-26: market/acceptance.py restored from archive (compare_canonical, independent_prefix, ReferenceBook) for finalize_market admission.
2026-10-26: outcomes.bands.future takes bid and ask; band exit E follows the bid OR ask rule (NaN if both lines are reached in one second); O, D, V stay on the mid.

2026-10-27: spectrum.outcomes renamed spectrum.future; every public function and field there is named future*; nearest_crossings -> future_crossings, endpoint_outcomes -> future_endpoint_move, sampled_crossing.targets -> future.sampled.future_first_crossing, opportunity.measure -> causal_and_future, bands/opportunity keys prefixed future_; economics.crossing_marks -> future_crossing_marks.
2026-10-27: model input rejects any field containing 'future' (features.contract.reject_future in FeatureBatch, Context.add, SequenceStore, publish_observation_store).

2026-10-27: crossing store CROSSING_BANK_LIBRARY_V3 keeps events plus reduced quote tape; open_bank returns (bank, tape, manifest); crossings.build and CLI 'bank' build one bank per day; vwap_bands moved to crossings.vwap.
2026-10-27: data/derived/bb_crossing_bank_v1 and _superseded_id moved to data/legacy; data/derived/bb_crossing_bank_v2 built for 238 days (bid OR ask).
